question: On the flat-FLRW quasilongitudinal scalar sector of the primary nonprojectable local-U1 equations, is the Newtonian-prepotential constraint Eq.(7.10) a derived Ward-consistency equation once the A constraint Eq.(7.11), momentum constraint Eq.(7.12), and the locally U1-invariant matter-source Ward identity are imposed for k>0?

primary_equations.gauge_background: flat FLRW; quasilongitudinal gauge E=delta_varphi=0; background N=a and N^i=0
primary_equations.eq_7_10: partial2[2 H(psi-phi)+(1-lambda)(partial2 B+3 psi_prime+3 H phi)] = 8 pi G a^3 delta J_varphi
primary_equations.eq_7_11: partial2 psi = 2 pi G a^2 delta J_A
primary_equations.eq_7_12: (3 lambda-1)(psi_prime+H phi)+(lambda-1) partial2 B = 8 pi G a q

frozen_source_map.linear_Ward_FLRW: delta J_varphi = a^-1[(delta P)'+3 H delta P-a^-1 partial2 q]
frozen_source_map.note: The q term follows from delta J^i=a^-2 partial^i q and J^i=-s^i in the family-I source bridge.

acceptance: derive 8 pi G a^3 delta J_varphi = 8 pi G a^2[(delta P)'+3 H delta P]-8 pi G a partial2 q
differentiate Eq.(7.11) with delta J_A=2 delta P and retain the derivative of a^-2 exactly
show 8 pi G a^2[(delta P)'+3 H delta P] = 2 partial2(psi_prime+H psi)
therefore show the prepotential RHS equals partial2[2(psi_prime+H psi)-8 pi G a q]
for k>0 cancel the common partial2 operator only after explicitly stating the k=0 exclusion
substitute Eq.(7.12) for 8 pi G a q
prove the resulting bracket is exactly 2 H(psi-phi)+(1-lambda)(partial2 B+3 psi_prime+3 H phi), with zero symbolic residual
classify Eq.(7.10) as a derived linear Ward-consistency relation in this scoped sector, not as an independent source equation
preserve Eq.(7.11) as the extra A constraint responsible for the non-GR scalar restriction; do not claim all extra U1 constraints disappear
non_claims: does not cover the exact homogeneous k=0 mode where partial2 cannot be cancelled
does not prove nonlinear prepotential-equation redundancy
does not close the Hamiltonian constraint Eq.(7.13)
does not close trace/traceless dynamical Eqs.(7.14)-(7.15)
does not implement CLASS or alter any likelihood
does not close massive-neutrino anisotropic stress or B4
